title: ARTIFACTS
text:
Some engineering problems
should only be solved once.
caption: From a recurring problem to a body of work.

title:
Again.
And again.
text:
A log to read. A recipe to check.
Another chart. Another manual step.
caption: Logs · recipes · measurements · signals · schedules

title:
The problem wasn’t
the engineering.
text: It was doing the same work again.
caption: Repetition becomes something you can design out.

title:
One problem.
One tool.
text:
Keep the method.
Let software carry the repetition.
caption: A useful answer, made reusable.

title:
One tool became many.
Many became a system.
caption: Sixteen applications. Four Expeditions.

title:
The order changed.
Did the meaning?
text:
Two recipes. Equivalent steps.
Different places to look.
caption: Follow the steps, not their line numbers.

title:
Let the differences
speak.
text:
Equivalent steps find each other.
Changed, added and missing values stay visible.
caption: Logical comparison, independent of line order.

title:
A set of points.
A larger picture.
text:
Every measurement has a place.
The pattern lives between them.
caption: The comparison guide becomes a measurement axis.

title:
See the shape
of variation.
text:
Wafer measurements become a contour map.
Spatial variation comes into view.
caption: Samples → interpolation → wafer-scale context

title:
A drift is a signal.
Where does it lead?
text:
Temperature behavior provides clues.
The next step is knowing what to check.
caption: A spatial field becomes a diagnostic question.

title:
Fewer possibilities.
A clearer next step.
text:
Observations guide likely causes
and recommended checks.
caption: Observed behavior → guided diagnosis

title:
Bring the signals
into the same view.
text:
Related parameters. Interactive charts.
One place to follow the equipment.
caption: Individual signals become a shared context.

title:
16 applications.
One engineering environment.
text:
Each solves something specific.
Together, they are ARTIFACTS.
caption: Choose an instrument to see its work and related tools.

title:
Real software.
Built for real engineering work.
caption: Original software captures. Actual interface detail.
